messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: markdown into one code block
parts:
Hi,

say, here is a Rmd file:

=============
```{r prompt=TRUE, comment=NA}
a <- 1
a
```
=============

after knitting by

> knit("a.Rmd")

then I get:

=============
```r
> a <- 1
> a
```



```
[1] 1
```
=============

Thus, the sources and results are in the separate blocks.
But what I want is:

=============
```r
> a <- 1
> a

[1] 1
```
=============

Of course I can do this by tweaking the output, but is there any
options inside knitr?

Thanks in advance,

kohske


--
Kohske Takahashi <takahash...@gmail.com>

parts:
You are always free to wrestle with knitr output if you are
unsatisfied with the default output :) I just cooked up a small
example: https://gist.github.com/2629886#file_knitr_merge.rmd

Regards,
Yihui
